title: What is real are practically ineffable properties tracked by idiosyncratic detectors

statements.text: In place of qualia are relatively or practically ineffable public properties, referred to through personal, idiosyncratic property-detectors. That idiosyncrasy is the extent of privacy. Subjective authority holds only for relational properties such as the power of internal states to provoke apparent re-identification.

sources.quote: In their place are relatively or practically ineffable public properties we can refer to indirectly via reference to our private property-detectors
That idiosyncracy is the extent of our privacy.
